mutation_protocol.candidate_access: read-only; no suite or oracle ran in the candidate directory
mutation_protocol.copy_policy: Each control and mutant used a separate TemporaryDirectory copy with .git, .until-loop, bytecode caches omitted.
mutation_protocol.mutation_scope: Only importer.py was changed in each mutant copy.
mutation_protocol.oracle: A separate Python subprocess loaded importer.py and checked named quoted parsing, malformed diagnostic, and continuation assertions.

reviews.finding_summary: Blank-name fallback and missing regression coverage were material defects. Commit 57f640b repaired them; five postcommit tests passed.
Distinct no-change self-review reread history and scoped files. Nine boundary cases passed; existing suite evidence remained current. No commit was required.

Distinct no-change self-review checked test adequacy, committed diff and ownership. Reused checks remain current for final observed candidate digest 91d481ea970c0769889bc766bf5eb51c0d60ee657884b91bfc3f86f59e602650. No commit was required.
Completed substantive history and candidate review found no warranted change. Four tests and eight literal behavior probes passed; candidate and user work remained unchanged. No commit required.

Distinct follow-up reread and coverage assessment found no warranted change. Prior passing checks remained applicable after candidate and environment comparison. Final observed digest: d15442bf1e37f1321b4f7560f0c357fee940da057397ede6b84df366f253ece1. No commit required.

Identified and repaired broken CSV quoting, missing width diagnostics, and premature termination. Regression failures preceded the fix; all 10 tests passed after scoped commit d1788f93163b1224417aa43001625a2a63ba1b40.

Distinct parser-boundary self-review reread the candidate and seven full commit messages. All 363 integration cases and the README example passed; retained regression checks remained current. No warranted changes or commit required.

Distinct coverage self-review found no warranted changes on final observed digest 1b01d67f62b74bfa9f952b2a560fe10137eff5c1d35bf0eb846e5d34c108e1b7. The 10-test control passed, six in-memory regressions were rejected, and final checks and preservation evidence remained current. No commit required.
Confirmed cross-tenant leakage and overwrites. Committed tuple-key repair and five regression tests; four pre-repair failures became seven passing tests, refreshed after commit.

Separate scope, history, and prior-evidence review examined tuple identity and contract coverage. No warranted changes; unchanged candidate hashes and Python version support reusing the seven-test pass. No commit required.

Separate contract-to-assertion and regression-sensitivity review found no warranted changes. Current checks and ownership reconciliation cover final candidate digest 10223e40e67b1dea0e4f8465ed9a8949ce19cdcb2016c87f5b0ac3e6061d823d. No commit required.

Completed source and seven-message history review. Correctly declined strip-only suggestion because blank names require Anonymous. Four tests and seven boundary checks passed; candidate unchanged. Durable no-change record satisfies commit policy.

Distinct subsequent source/history review and triage found no warranted changes. Prior passing checks remain current after file and environment verification; independent rerun is only reported. No commit required. Final observed candidate digest: 5c17fad200bde2a32ba4051d9cdfb6200c40d36fa16e1fb920b586cd4115d9e7.
Material missing Anonymous fallback repaired with demonstrated failing-then-passing regressions. Scoped commit succeeded after retry; postcommit checks passed. Commit retries belong to this review.
Distinct history-informed contract review inspected both formatter branches and preservation coverage. No changes warranted; five tests and scoped diff check passed. No commit required.

Distinct boundary and regression review found no warranted changes. Reused passing checks remained current on final observed candidate digest 0596c051eed9ae024367a6ef4e53c2a7f6fe999cbbf83e499a743c3fcdf5f3b0. Final inventory reconciled; no commit required.
Repaired the documented blank-name fallback and disabled regression coverage. Three blank-input assertions failed before repair; all seven tests passed afterward. Scoped commit 4b9a1c4 is verified.

Separate history, source, diff, and regression review found no warranted changes. Boundary probes passed; existing tests and diff checks remained current. Reference-binding correction was bookkeeping within this review.

Separate history, source, diff, and test-sensitivity review found no changes. Seven tests passed and ownership inventory reconciled. Final observed candidate digest: d84ffc03ac72664661f8d38b074581425039851035b61b4ccc88dc94df7b1c88.

Corrected a failing expectation that contradicted the documented Anonymous fallback and added missing preservation coverage. Scoped commit 2dde733 contains the material test changes; all seven tests pass afterward.

Distinct candidate and history review supported no changes. The whitespace diagnostic resolved the raised boundary question. Passing checks remained current on the unchanged candidate; no commit was required.

Separate review assessed assertion strength and final preservation evidence, finding no warranted change. Passing checks remain current for final observed candidate digest 7b89d2e8456fc77dbb974fe8653f5c0aafed4c02424c8fbcf6b51f2c44f4213b; no new commit was required.
Completed source/history review found no warranted change. Retained checks match the candidate and agree with snapshot behavior results. No commit required.
Reproduced the missing blank-name fallback and restored Anonymous in commit 8be3c3e. Postcommit tests pass; the semantic repair remains material.
Separate history, contract, branch and coverage review found no warranted change. Passing checks were explicitly revalidated against unchanged source and environment. No commit required.

Separate source/history review found no warranted change on final observed digest 70083fa7a996c7bcc65df1ddffbe9a625c605c93e6cd3c88e4db12516d32e9db. Passing checks remain current; final inventory is reconciled. No commit required.

limits: Unsealed same-host pilot; absence of observed key access is not enforced isolation.
One selected autonomous run per fixture, not a reliability estimate or the proposed repeated suite.
Fresh retrospective auditors interpret actual self-reviews; runtime cycle counts are not substituted for reviews.
Final deterministic requalification retains the original semantic judgments; it does not reroll model answers.
Package, installed skills and marketplace pins were not changed by this study.
